name: Trivial Performer
body:
Your performance is light-hearted and has little effect on others.

Prerequisite: Bardic Music Ability

Effect: The save DC against your fascinate, suggestion, and mass suggestion abilities is half normal (round down). Your ‘inspire…’ Bardic music abilities stop providing any benefits as soon as you stop performing.

Source not confirmed for this entry. If this is your work, use the Feedback link below to let us know so we can credit it properly.
